overall_notes: This paper is primarily about model-based retrieval using generative models (T5), but focuses on retrieval performance rather than NLG quality evaluation. The NLG aspects (generating passages and URLs) are means to the retrieval end. The evaluation is purely automatic using retrieval metrics (Hits@1) and training metrics (Perplexity), with no human or LLM-based evaluation of generation quality.
